title: Explosions at Saky air base in Crimea
body:
On the afternoon of 9 August 2022, a series of explosions occurred at a Russian military airbase near Novofedorivka in the Saky district of Russian-occupied Crimea. Reuters-sourced reports counted at least a dozen blasts at around 3:20 p.m. local time.

Ukrainska Pravda reported that the Russian-appointed head of Crimea, Sergey Aksyonov, said on Telegram that five people had been wounded, and later that one person had been killed. According to the publication, four of the injured had glass cuts and were treated as outpatients, while a fifth with a penetrating chest wound underwent surgery in moderate condition. These figures came from Russian-appointed authorities and were not independently verified.

The Russian Ministry of Defence said that no one had shelled the base and that stored ammunition had detonated. A TASS source later described the cause as a violation of fire safety rules. Ukraine did not claim responsibility. Presidential adviser Mykhailo Podolyak denied that Ukraine was involved, and Ukraine's Defence Ministry said it could not establish the cause. Ukrainian Air Force spokesman Yuriy Ihnat estimated that an aviation weapons depot and about a dozen aircraft had been destroyed, an assessment Moscow rejected, saying no aircraft were damaged.
